text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Nishino Flower in the hallway,
chatting with her classmates.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Nishino-chan, are you feeling tired by any chance?
Then let me give you some headpats~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Good on you for always trying your best~♪
There, there~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That wasn't the reaction I expected.
Usually she'd get embarrassed and laugh shyly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-No, um... I just kind of thought
something like this was nice too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower seems to be exhausted from her races.
It might be best to reconsider her race schedule.
